pick.headline: Nicolae and Elena Ceausescu tried and executed
pick.summary: On 25 December 1989 Nicolae and Elena Ceausescu were tried by a hastily convened military tribunal at Targoviste and shot.
pick.significance: Their execution was meant to end Securitate resistance; footage was shown on Romanian television the next day.

alternates.headline: Gorbachev resigns as Soviet president
alternates.summary: On 25 December 1991 Mikhail Gorbachev resigned as President of the USSR in a televised address, and the Soviet flag was lowered over the Kremlin.
alternates.significance: The end of the Soviet Union closed the Cold War.
